controls.data: Tiny generated byte files named as archives; never unpacked or executed. Sparse over-limit file tests metadata rejection without reading/allocating its declared512MiB content.

option.name: RESECTIONLAB_ELECTRON_ZIP_DIR
option.scope: Host build environment only; no renderer/runtime API.

behavior: Version is first checked against captured pnpm lock and installed Electron package.
Optional explicit absolute directory must be canonical with no symlink ancestry; exact standard darwin-arm64 filename must be regular, non-symlink, nonempty and <=512MiB.
Bounded streamed SHA256 equals installed upstream checksum. File identity, size and nanosecond metadata checked during read.
Check occurs before renderer compilation, again immediately before packager, and after packager before engine copy/signing/publication. Replaced identical bytes also fail the identity postcheck.
Explicit mode passes electronZipDir to existing packager local-archive path; missing or invalid input throws, no repair or download fallback.
Absent variable preserves current checksum-managed download/cache behavior. Empty-but-set fails closed.
Build manifest records local archive filename, bytes and digest without adding absolute archive path to the app manifest.
Notices, snapshot capture, internal symlink verification, ad-hoc signing and publication machinery remain in place.

exact_future_package_command.prerequisites: Separate ROOT build release, successful new current-source sidecar and notices, final source freeze and host-folder UI QA.
